description: This file defines utility functions for creating and manipulating ATen storage implementations, including shared memory storage and copying storage data.

methods.name: new_shm_fd_storage
methods.description: Creates a new shared memory storage implementation managed by a file descriptor, given a size in bytes.

methods.name: storage_copy
methods.description: Copies data from source storage to destination storage, with an option for non-blocking operation.

methods.name: share_memory_
methods.description: Modifies a tensor to share its memory via shared memory, applicable only to CPU tensors not already shared.
